methodology.units: USD millions / million ordinary economic units; per-share amounts USD
methodology.periodConvention: Ten annual research periods ending November 4, 2027 through November 4, 2036; 2031 is exactly five years. These are not fiscal-year forecasts.

openingCashBridge.note: Only June cash, gross July proceeds and capped-call total are reported facts. July total net proceeds assumes the same 1.64% all-in fee ratio as the reported initial $1bn/$983.6m net; option-size fee may differ. All July-November uses are research estimates, not actual November liquidity. They cover the historical bridge only; first forecast period includes November-December 2026, so there is no omitted future stub or duplicate four-month burn.

methodology.openingPaidSatelliteWipNote: Research estimate, not reported fact: $1,724.085m June satellite/WIP/launch prepayments is not all usable future-production cash credit. Retain $1,200m estimated prepaid content at November 4 after deployments, timing, non-usable/design and other-content haircuts. Apply this credit against future gross satellite procurement exactly once. Sensitivity 0 to $1,700m; WIP is not added as a separate financial asset.
methodology.openingOperatingNwcNote: Research starting proxy, not precise November balance. June AR79.297+inventory28.417+prepaid16.729 minus AP60.615 and selected operating accruals46.862 equals16.966; capex content and intervening movements are unresolved. Do not include contract liabilities in NWC, because their future noncash recognition is deducted separately.
methodology.minimumCashPolicy: Research liquidity reserve required to continue the modeled project. Falling below it triggers an assumed project stop with zero common liquidation recovery, not a claim of legal insolvency or proven zero asset value. Report actual ending cash and reserve gap separately. Reserve remains committed operating liquidity and is not added as excess cash to terminal equity.
methodology.existingAwardsNote: 12.159478m probable service/performance awards from diluted-EPS note fully included immediately, with no option exercise proceeds credited; conservative forfeiture/proceeds simplification. No future compensation awards are silently free: modeled future compensation is included as an economic cash replacement cost in fixed operating expenses. No future compensation-share addback/dilution on top. Additional contingent award overhang 2.852222m is sensitivity only.
methodology.normalTaxNote: Conservative all-economic-units, fully exchanged Up-C proxy: 25% tax on positive earnings, no NOL/step-up asset credit, no incremental TRA tax benefit. No NCI book-value subtraction. Actual taxes differ between C-corporation and LLC holders; TRA acceleration tail cannot be quantified from disclosed no-liability balance.
methodology.prepaymentNote: The full June $266.933m current+noncurrent contract liability, including SatCo contributed distribution-right deferred revenue, is treated as noncash recognition included in projected gross revenue and deducted from future collections. No new MNO prepayment source assumed. NWC excludes contract liabilities, preventing a second deduction.
methodology.trinityNote: June balance held as conservative November proxy; annual principal timing research approximation to four five-year 2025 schedules with about $1.1m aggregate monthly payment and 9% end payment on $50.5m drawn. 12% modeled cash rate approximation; no undrawn $49.5m commitment counted as cash or financing.
methodology.ubsTreatment: UBS principal420 and minimum collateral428.4 are matched outside free operating cash/debt. Collateral cash earns assumed benchmark matching benchmark borrowing cost; only contractual 2% spread ($8.4m/year) modeled through October2028, then residual8.4 released in period2028. $6.181m other restricted cash has no credited value. No Sound Point conditional facility is drawn or treated as cash.
methodology.otherSpectrumClosingNote: Future cash: remaining Ligado closing30m plus all81.3m June stock-optional spectrum fees assumed settled in cash in period2027 (conservative no-subsequent-payment-credit choice). S-band anniversary10m in2028; next anniversary10m plus conditional satellite18.5m in2029. Already-paid Ligado520m and already-exercised warrants are not paid again. Future annual spectrum cash expense is separately in EBITDA. Opening81.3m is settlement of already capitalized/accrued access rights, distinct from new future-year100m+ expense; no stock-share benefit/dilution also counted for the same81.3m.
methodology.initialCohortNote: IR 13 in-orbit spacecraft includes the test spacecraft: operational commercial proxy5 Block1+BB6+BB8-13=12; BB7 lost. Block1 five-year accounting life respected; Block2 life is scenario assumption, not guaranteed up-to-ten-year design life. Initial unit-cost book proxies are assumptions.
methodology.payoutConvention: No distributions in first five research periods; from period6 distribute all cash above $500m floor after capex, debt settlement and equity funding. These are owner-valuation cash distributions, not a prediction or announcement of company dividends. Five-year price excludes earlier dividends because first-five dividends are zero.
methodology.cappedCallTreatment: Baseline excludes all capped-call recoveries, after deducting purchase cash. Legal July conversion strike is $79.57, not $149.20 cap. This understates possible equity benefit and avoids relying on hedge-counterparty settlement/adjustments. Separate maximum July benefit sensitivity shown.
methodology.noteSettlementConvention: No assumed early conversion. At contractual maturity in the annual period, pay principal in cash if modeled ex-/cum-distribution common price is below strike, otherwise deliver principal/strike shares. Enumerate 32 treatment combinations and require self-consistency of maturity-year common value with strike. Exact intra-year path, make-whole rate changes, put/redemption events and option time value are not modeled; this is a conditional annual maturity proxy, not convertible fair-value pricing.

stress.financingValidityNote: All funding caps and issueprices are research assumptions, not committed facilities. Base2029/30/34/36 assumed issueprices22/25/34/38 materially exceed same-case modeled common value near7/8/12/15; successful financing at these prices is not assured and must not support an unconditional entry ladder. Tenth-price stress exceeds current800m authorizedClassA capacity after awards/conversions and would require further shareholder authorization; it is conditional on that authorization as well as funding, not presently executable capacity.
stress.noFurtherFinancingTail: If equity/launch/spectrum authorizations cannot be obtained, operating case does not survive. Common value can be0. No probabilities invented.
stress.cappedCallBenefitNote: Undiscounted theoretical maximum for July calls only, if valid and fullysettled in-the-money at cap; not included baseline; no double use of spent premium or legal conversionstrike.

reverse.method: Solve uniform multiplier on base paid-equivalent users only; keep base retail/share/margins/fleet/capex/financing policies and taxes. This is one conditional solution, not the actual unique market forecast.
reverse.feasibility: No independently disclosed sustainable whole-satellite throughput, busy-hour geographic loading, churn, realized ARPU or commercial capacity sold. Holding the fleet fixed while scaling users is an unvalidated commercial/technical requirement, not proof it fits. Regional/spot-beam constraints can dominate global average.
